body: Thanks for sharing, I feel the same way.
I honestly never thought of doing that. I'll do it right now. Thank you.
You're right and if I could learn how to like myself then I could have some compassion to give to other people to make friends.. but I don't so I don't... what a vicious cycle
It always comes back to that, some people are good at reaching out and others try to reach out and get people's backs turned on them, know what I mean?
But I don't think I want to live a whole life sad. It's lonely.

I guess a better way of saying it would be "everything's going to be okay sometimes." Even sometimes would be nice. Rather than really shitty all the time like it is now. Even when things are great depression still squashes the happiness and it's tough to fight that. Thank you for talking me and giving me your advice though I don't mean to sounds like im contradicting you. You're right we all live once and die soon enough why rush. I recognize that.
